notes:
Fullobby 0.2.0

Autoseed now confirms before it starts. When a scheduled seed comes up you
get a "Seed now?" prompt showing the game and target server, with Seed Now,
Seed with Power Savings (on games that support it), and Cancel. If you are
away, the countdown proceeds using your remembered choice for that game.

The Seed button is now a split button on capable games: the main button uses
your remembered choice and the flyout always offers both options explicitly.
The old idle-panel power savings checkbox has been removed.

Also includes groundwork for multi-game support.
